// diagnostic

E1001

Unknown core module, or a Core-private `core.<area>.runtime` unit

What

Unknown core module, or a Core-private `core.<area>.runtime` unit

Why

A core import must name a declared public core module; only Core sources import `core.<area>.runtime` units.

Fix

Select a declared public core module.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1001: Tests/UI/CoreRuntimeUnits/user_program_cannot_import_a_runtime_unit.stderr.

Error [jet.UnknownCoreModule]: `core.text.runtime.kernel_unicode_string` is private to Core
  --> Tests/UI/CoreRuntimeUnits/user_program_cannot_import_a_runtime_unit.jet:1:9
    |
  1 | use rt: core.text.runtime.kernel_unicode_string
    |         ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: `core.<area>.runtime` units implement the Core library; only Core sources import them
 Fix: Use the public module `core.text` instead
